title: Sumitomo Chemical FY26 net profit rises 8.2% to ₹5,431.39 million Sumitomo Chemical India Limited reported an 8.2% increase in net profit to ₹5,431.39 million for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, driven by higher income. Revenue from operations rose to ₹31,857.62 million from ₹30,903.69 million in the previous year. The board has recommended a dividend of ₹1.3 per equity share, subject to shareholder approval

Smith, SueWallSt, and Robbins LLP are investigating Grail, Inc. for potential federal securities law violations related to misleading statements about its NHS-Galleri Trial.
